Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js) and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (*.wasm.js), Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-tesseract.
ocrb_int.traineddata: OCR-B model for passport / ID machine-readable lines, https://github.com/Shreeshrii/tessdata_ocrb (Apache-2.0), gzipped.
Loaded only when someone scans an ID. Everything runs in the browser.
